page.overview:
What is Radio Control?

Radio Control (also known as RC) is a technology used for wireless controlling of components in certain LEGO sets. In 2009 the more or less outstanding RC-technology feature became the central part of the Power Functions system.

The history of the Radio Control (RC) feature in LEGO has evolved across several themes before becoming standardized. Originally introduced as its own dedicated RC theme in 1998, the concept had a brief return in 2001 but did not extend into the following year. However, the technology was quickly incorporated into other product lines, notably becoming a key component of the Racers theme as RC Racers starting in 2003. This functionality was eventually centralized and integrated into the broader Power Functions system, where RC technology became the default wireless control feature starting in 2009.
